items.item_text: Completion of formal RN First Assistant (RNFA) education/certification
BLS from American Red Cross or American Heart association
Minimum 2 years of RNFA perioperative/operating room nursing experience, with experience in complex surgical procedures.

Provides advanced perioperative nursing care for complex surgical procedures, functioning as a circulating nurse, scrub nurse and first assistant as appropriate to the procedure and scope of practice. Collaborates closely with surgeons and the multidisciplinary surgical team to anticipate procedural needs, provides advanced intraoperative assistance, and promote safe, efficient, and high-quality patient care. Serves as a clinical resource for complex cases and supports the education and mentoring of perioperative nursing staff
Demonstrated competency in circulating, scrubbing and first assisting.
Flexible and able to take required call.
Advanced knowledge of surgical procedures, instrumentation, anatomy and aseptic technique
Ability to anticipate the needs of the surgeon and surgical team during complex procedures
Strong clinical judgement, critical thinking, communication and teamwork skills
Ability to push, pull, lift, up to 35 lbs
Ability to function independently and effectively in high acuity surgical environments.
